LAREDO, Texas — Joshua Ryan Galbreath was arrested Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 5:02 p.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail the same day on an alleged state jail felony charge of organized retail theft, according to Webb County booking records.

Galbreath was booked on two charges: organized retail theft of property valued at $750 or more but less than $2,500 — a state jail felony — with bond set at $10,000; and theft of property valued at $100 or more but less than $750 — a Class B misdemeanor — with bond set at $1,000.

The arrest was made by the Laredo Police Department, according to Webb County public-access court records. The booking record listed the city as Laredo, TX 78046.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Joshua Ryan Galbreath is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
